text:
jen: Heads up — release window blocked. CI started failing on post-build artifact copy step, looks like a cache namespace leak across jobs. deploy-bot paused auto-promo.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for build 2026.03.23-1145 due to failed post-build checksum. See logs: https://ci.internal/builds/20260323/1145

matt: looking. can you paste the failing line?

jen: here's the tail from build:
```
ERROR: failed to extract wheels: checksum mismatch for /cache/pip/wheels/rcutils-0.1.whl
Found cached wheel from job #8453 in namespace default
But artifact owner mismatch: job 8453 != job 2026
```

tara: hmm we've seen namespace leak before when runner didn't rotate ephemeral paths. suspect docker layer cache reused across matrix axes.

vic: agree. guess: shared volume mount on self-hosted runners. quick check: `kubectl get pv | grep runner-cache` shows persistent volumes with ReclaimPolicy Retain

matt: can we isolate by forcing fresh cache path for this release? e.g., set CI env RUNNER_CACHE_NAMESPACE=release-6381 and rerun.

jen: manual rerun would push us past change window. Product wants to cut tonight if possible.

deploy-bot: @jen Manual promote blocked until a successful smoke on staging is recorded.

tara: two options:
- pin to last-green image (sha: sha256:abc123) and promote manually (fast, but skips today's canary)
- roll forward: rebuild artifacts with forced fresh cache, rerun tests (slower, more confident)

matt: if we pin, we need to update release notes and feature flags to say today's changes are postponed. Also need approval from product for hotspot features.

vic: rebuilding with fresh cache will take ~45-60m for full matrix; but we can parallelize by axis — request 4 extra runners.

jen: request submitted to infra for extra runners. if infra can't, we may have to pin.

ci-bot: infra request #R-981 submitted. ETA for additional runners: 35 minutes.

tara: mitigations: add a pre-job step to `rm -rf /cache/pip/wheels/*` on runners that match the problematic PV label. quick patch in CI config:

```
steps:
 - run: if [ -d /cache/pip/wheels ]; then rm -rf /cache/pip/wheels || true; fi
```

matt: that's ok for now. but file permissions could still cause races. we should add namespace tags on PVs to prevent cross-job reuse in k8s.

jen: decision time: @vic @matt @tara — propose we wait for extra runners. if infra ETA > 40m, pin to sha256:abc123 and schedule a rebuild tomorrow morning during off-peak.

vic: +1 for wait up to 40m. If infra ETA longer, pin.

matt: +1

tara: +1

jen: OK decision: wait for infra up to 40m. If not resolved, pin to sha256:abc123 and cut release notes update. Notifying product.

jen: @product-team FYI — we may pin to last-green and postpone today's changes if runners unavailable within 40m.

product-bot: Acknowledged. Will prepare updated release notes if needed.

jen: thanks all. I'll post final decision in 35m.

deploy-bot: Promotion remain paused. Auto-retry disabled. /deploy status for manual commands.
